info.name:
SendGrid content and message data for the combined multi-coverage
manual application underwriter email.

items.docs:
Returns the template's latest active version (HTML and subject template)
together with the same ``message_data`` and ``subject`` the combined
underwriter email is built from, so the frontend can render the exact
email locally.

Query params:
- ``application_id``: application UUID (required). The message data is
  built directly from the application's coverage applications (ordered
  by creation), so it works before any quotes exist.
